judgment.rationale: The border alone does not demonstrate a failed region selector, and changing a shortcut without confirming which machine receives it does not identify a ZoomIt defect. The unresolved issue is whether the same configured capture hotkeys work on the local desktop versus inside RDP, including starting a fresh crop session rather than trying to resize an active full-screen recording. Do not prescribe a speculative RDP registry tweak.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a local-versus-RDP fresh-session comparison and the exact Windows build; retain existing version and log evidence.

title: Zoomit Record did anyone test it?

comment.body:
Thanks for the supplied log and additional shortcut tests. The log contains initialization only, so it does not identify a recording failure. ZoomIt documents separate shortcuts for full-screen start/stop (Ctrl+5 by default), crop recording (Ctrl+Shift+5) and window recording (Ctrl+Alt+5); the yellow capture border is not a draggable crop editor. Please provide these two discriminating details:

1. Stop any current recording, then compare fresh full-screen and fresh crop activation using your configured shortcuts on the local desktop and inside RDP. Which computer/process responds in each case?
2. Copy the exact Windows version/build from winver on the computer running ZoomIt.

This distinguishes remote key delivery from a general hotkey or capture problem; the supplied evidence is retained.

fix_assessment.rationale: Hotkey/capture-routing investigation remains applicable, but there is no supported implementation correction without the discriminating comparison.

proposed_fixes.title: Identify recording hotkey routing versus crop-mode behavior
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Remote key routing, hotkey registration or capture-state behavior could explain ineffective shortcuts. Existing evidence does not distinguish them; a visible full-screen capture border is not itself a crop-mode defect.
verification: Configured full-screen shortcut starts/stops recording; a fresh crop shortcut enters the documented region flow.
Local/RDP comparisons identify the receiving process and recording output; confirm customized shortcuts and stop/restart behavior.

confidence.rationale: The log has no failing operation and the remote/local and active/fresh mode boundaries remain unresolved.

plan: Compare fresh full-screen and crop activation locally and inside the same RDP session, confirming the process and computer receiving each configured chord.
Trace registration and received hotkey IDs only on a reproducing maintainer setup; compare supported recording builds.
Fix the demonstrated routing/state defect or clarify the documented mode interaction, without treating the capture border as an editable selection.
